content.text:
=== 1. Frontend HTML ===
HTTP 200
<title>Leipziger Strassennamen</title>
=== 2. Served dev config ===
{
  "endPointUrl": "http://localhost:5000/api",
  "keycloak": {
    "realm": "my-realm",
    "authServerUrl": "http://localhost:8080/",
    "resource": "strassennamen"
  }
}
=== 3. CORS preflight from frontend origin ===
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:4200
=== 4. CORS actual response ===
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:4200

observation.command:
echo "=== 1. Frontend HTML ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:4200/ -o /tmp/index.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" && grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/index.html
echo "=== 2. Served dev config ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:4200/configs/config.development.json
echo "=== 3. CORS preflight from frontend origin ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 -X OPTIONS "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" -D - -o /dev/null | grep -i "access-control-allow"
echo "=== 4. CORS actual response ==="; UTOK=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=strassennamen" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=user1" -d "password=user1pass" | jq -r .access_token); curl -s --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTOK" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse?skip=0&take=1" -D - -o /dev/null | grep -i "HTTP/\|access-control-allow-origin"
